2d_oriented_bbox_qa_detect_category.description: Return an array containing one object with 'oriented_bbox_2d' (u, v, width, height, angle) and an optional 'label' and 'description'.

2d_oriented_bbox_qa_single_part_with_des.description: Return an array containing one object representing a single detected part with 'oriented_bbox_2d' (u, v, width, height, angle), an optional 'label', and optional 'description' for human-readable details.

2d_oriented_bbox_qa_single_with_desc.description: Return an array containing one object with 'oriented_bbox_2d' (cx, cy, width, height, angle), an optional 'label', and optional 'description' for human-readable details.

3d_bbox_qa_single_part_with_desc.description: Return an array containing one object representing a single detected 3D part with 'bbox_uvd' (center(u,v,depth) + size and optional rotation fields), an optional 'label', and optional 'description' for human-readable details.

obj_bbox_qa_detect_category_3d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'bbox_uvd' (center + size and optional rotation fields; at least first 6 values: [cx,cy,cz,sx,sy,sz]) and an optional 'label' and 'description'.

obj_bbox_qa_single_with_desc_3d.description:
Please output each 3D bounding box in the following JSON format exactly (an array of objects):
[{"bbox_uvd":[u, v, depth, x_size, y_size, z_size, roll, pitch, yaw], "label":"category"}]

Notes:
(1) u,v,depth: center of the object in the camera coordinate system, u and v is point in the image, depth is the point's depth in meters.
(2) x_size, y_size, z_size: object dimensions along the X, Y, Z axes respectively (meters) when rotation angles are zero.
(3) roll, pitch, yaw: Euler angles (radians) representing rotations around X, Y, Z axes respectively.
Detect all objects in this image and return the results as the JSON array above.

correspondence_pairs_customized_2d.description: Return an array of correspondence pair objects each with 'label', 'description', 'point_2d' as [x,y], and boolean 'visible'.

correspondence_pairs_customized_3d.description: Return an array of correspondence pair objects each with 'label', 'description', 'point_uvd' as [u, v, depth] (depth in meters), and boolean 'visible'.

correspondence_pairs_single_object_2d.description: Return an array containing one correspondence pair object for a single 2D object with fields 'label','description','point_2d', and 'visible'.

correspondence_pairs_single_object_3d.description: Return an array containing one correspondence pair object for a single 3D object with fields 'label','description','point_uvd' as [u, v, depth] (depth in meters), and 'visible'.

grasp_point_2d.description: Return an array containing one or more objects each with 'grasp_point_2d' as [x,y] in image pixels and an optional 'label'.

grasp_point_3d.description: Return an array containing one or more objects each with 'grasp_point_uvd' as [u,v,depth], depth in meters and an optional 'label'.

object_point_qa_detect_category_2d.description: Return an array containing one object representing the detected instances of the requested category (e.g., all 'orange' instances collapsed to a single representative).

object_point_qa_detect_category_3d.description: Return an array containing one object representing the detected instances of the requested 3D category (single representative center_3d).

object_point_qa_single_with_desc_2d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'center_2d' as [x,y], an optional 'label', and an optional 'description' field for human-readable details.

object_point_qa_single_with_desc_3d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'center_3d' as [u,v,depth], depth in meters, an optional 'label', and an optional 'description' field for human-readable details.

single_func_point_2d.description: Return a JSON array of objects each containing 'functional_point_2d' as a point [x,y], a 'label' and optional 'confidence'.

single_func_point_3d.description: Return a JSON array of objects each containing 'functional_point_uv_depth' as a 3D-point [u,v,depth], depth in meters, a 'label' and optional 'confidence'.

single_func_vector_2d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'functional_vector' as a 2D-vector [vx,vy] and an optional 'label'.

single_func_vector_3d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'functional_vector' as a 3D vector [vx,vy,vz] and an optional 'label'.

single_part_point_2d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'functional_point_2d' as [x,y] representing a single detected part point, along with an optional 'label' and optional 'description'.

single_part_point_3d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'functional_point_3d' as [x,y,z] representing a single detected 3D part point, along with an optional 'label' and optional 'description'.

spatial_rel_qa_obj2cam_distance.description: Return an array with at least one object containing numeric 'distance_meters' (meters).

spatial_rel_qa_obj2obj_choice.description: Return an array with one object with 'spatial_relation_choice' set to the chosen option (single uppercase letter) and optional 'label'.

spatial_rel_qa_obj2obj_distance.description: Return an array with at least one object containing numeric 'distance_meters' (meters).

traj_qa_prediction_2d.description: Return an object containing '2d_trajectory' whose value is a list of 2D points [[x,y], ...].

traj_qa_prediction_3d.description: Return an object containing 'uvd_trajectory' whose value is a list of 3D points [[u,v,depth], ...], depth in meters.
